Subject: Recording request — short customer story

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — our ops team is excited about the latency improvements. Marketing would like to capture a short on-camera case story (2–3 minutes) highlighting how Redwood reduced inference cost for our pilot.

We were hoping to schedule a quick onsite shoot the week of Sept 27 (we're in SF). Primary participants: me (marketing lead) and Tom Alvarez (CTO). We'd prefer natural-light interviews and 1–2 b-roll shots in our control room.

Would Redwood be able to provide:
- A simple script/talking points for Tom and me
- A one-page release form we can sign
- A brief call sheet with timing (we have a 2-hour window)

Happy to kick off with a 20-min planning call if helpful.

Best,
Sophie

Marissa / Naomi — Sophie at Orchard Health wants a 2–3 min on-camera case. Key asks below. Please advise on: scripting tone (brand-aligned vs. conversational), any legal redlines on the release, and availability for Sept 28/29.

Quick context: pilot showed ~40% token-cost reduction with our caching + batching config. Customer would like the story to focus on operational impact, not deep technical details.

Marissa: can you draft 3 talking prompts for each participant (Sophie + Tom) that surface product impact and metrics succinctly?
Naomi: can you prepare a call sheet and the release PDF we normally use for 3rd-party shoots? If you need the HubSpot deal link or any background assets, I added it below.

Thank you,
Jonas

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-18T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Recording request — short customer story

Thanks Jonas. Draft talking prompts below — keep the answers short (20–40s each). We should aim for a warm, product-led narrative. Please review and confirm before we send to Sophie.

Sophie (Marketing Lead) — prompts:
1) "Tell us briefly about the problem you were trying to solve before Redwood."
2) "What changed operationally after you piloted Redwood? Any measurable wins?"
3) "What would you tell a peer considering Redwood?"

Tom (CTO) — prompts:
1) "Walk through the technical constraint that made latency/cost challenging."
2) "What aspect of Redwood's runtime or routing made the biggest difference?"
3) "How did the team measure success during the pilot?"

Editorial notes:
- Keep metrics explicit (e.g., % reduction in token costs, latency window improvements).
- No mention of internal roadmap or unreleased features.
- Lower-thirds: "Sophie Lang — Head of Marketing, Orchard Health" / "Tom Alvarez — CTO, Orchard Health" (confirm spellings).

Naomi — if possible, align the call sheet for a 2-hour window: 30 min setup / 12 min Sophie interview / 12 min Tom / 15 min b-roll / wrap + buffer. I'll draft the outreach email once we confirm date/time.

- Marissa
